tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i gzhi bsnyen dang kha gso'i bsnyen pa byed tshul gyi yi ge 'phrin las bsam 'phel bzhugs// na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ 'dir 'khor lo bde mchog slob dpon nag po pa lugs kyi bsnyen pa la/ gzhi bsnyen dang / dbang bskur sgrub mchod kyi rdo rje slob dpon sogs byed pa'i kha gso'i bsnyen pa gnyis las/ dang po la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ rgyas pa ni/ rtsa rgyud du/ sa steng 'di na rin chen bzhi/ /phreng ba'i sngags ni dam pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yab yum gyi rtsa sngags gnyis med/ snying po gnyis med/ nye snying gnyis med/ go cha gnyis med rnams la 'bum phrag bzhi kha skong dang bcas pa bzla ba yin la/ gnyis pa gzhi bsnyen 'bring po'i lugs ni/ rtsa sngags gnyis med bzhag pa'i gzhan gsum la grangs gong du bshad pa ltar dang / 'khor rnams la khri phrag bzhi re bzlas pas zla ba drug tsam gyi bar du 'gro ba 'di yin zhing / gsum pa gzhi bsnyen bsdus pa'i lugs kyi sngags kyi grangs tshad ni/ chos rje glo bo mkhan chen pas bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug la gnang ba'i 'khor lo bde mchog gi bsnyen pa bya tshul gyi yi ge las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ bzlas pa'i grangs ni gzhi bsnyen dang / kha gso gnyis su yod la/ de yang mngon brjod le'u bzhi par/ rnal 'byor pa yis ma nor bar/ /bzlas pa khri'am 'bum du bya/ /zhes bshad pas khri zhes pa'i kha gso dang / 'bum zhes pas gzhi bsnyen bstan te/ nag po dkyil chog tu/ dpa' bo'i snying po'i gsang sngags ni/ /khri phrag gsum du bzlas brjod bya/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo'i/ /khri phrag gnyis ni bsnyen pa bya/ /zhes dang / rtsa rgyud le'u bcu gnyis par/ nye snying la dgongs nas/ gsang sngags 'di dag 'bum bzlas na/ /'jig rten gsum yang g.yo bar byed/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /des na gzhi bsnyen gyi skabs su/

sdom byung las bshad pa ltar gtso bo dang gtso mo la rtsa sngags snying po nye snying gsum po gang rung la 'bum phrag bzhi bzhi/ 'khor rnams la rtsa sngags sogs so sor phye ba med kyang / rang rang gi sngags rnams khri phrag bzhi bzhi bzla dgos pa don yin zhing / phyag len la lū nag gnyis kyi skabs su yab kyi snying po dang / yum gyi snying po gnyis la 'bum phrag bzhi bzhi/ yab kyi nye snying dang yum gyi nye snying gnyis la 'bum phrag re re mdzad pa'i lugs gcig kyang mchis/ 'bum phrag bzhi bzhi byung na shin tu yang legs/ yum gyi snying po dang nye snying la/ snying po ni/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa ni sogs dang / nye snying / oṃ sarba buddha sogs la rtsa rgyud dang / mngon spyod du bshad cing / nā ro pa'i man ngag gi snga ma nye snying dang / phyi ma snying por mdzad kyang gsungs zhes mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams lhun grub kyi gsung las ji ltar 'byung ba de bzhin du nyams su len dgos pa yin pas thun re'i mgo la/ yab yum gyi rtsa sngags gnyis med ji tsam nus pa dang / oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru dang / bai ro tsā ni ste yab yum gyi snying po gnyis la 'bum phrag bzhi re dang / oṃ hri ha ha dang / sarba buddha ste nye snying gnyis la 'bum phrag re re sogs dang yang nye snying gnyis la bzhi khri re'am/ ci nus re bzla ba ma gtogs grangs mi 'dzin pa'i phyag len yang snang bas gang bde bya zhing / oṃ ḍā ki ni sogs snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags sumbha ni dang spel ba dang / gzhan thugs gsung sku'i lha tshogs kyi sngags/ oṃ ka ra ka ra pra tsaṇḍe sogs dang / sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi sngags/ oṃ kā kā sye sogs yab kyi rkang brgyad dang spel ba ste/ 'khor gyi sngags de thams cad khri phrag bzhi bzhi bzla zhing / de thams cad kha skong dang bcas pa dag gsal lhag chad med pa gal che bas de bzhin du dgongs 'tshal zhing /

yang gzhi bsnyen gyi skabs 'dir yang / lū nag gi lugs kyi dbye ba'i/ rgyas bsdus kyi dbang gis ma mo bcu gnyis kyi sngags dang / zhal bzhi pa dang / rkang brgyad spel med du bzla ba'i phyag len yang snang bas/ rang gi blo la gang 'thad byas pas chog pa lags/ gnyis pa slob ma dbang bskur ba dang / sgrub mchod kyi rdo rje slob dpon sogs kyi sgo nas bdag 'jug len pa'i dkyil 'khor re rnams bri re bzhin bya dgos pa'i kha gso'i bsnyen pa'i sngags kyi grangs tshad ni/ nag po spyod pa'i dkyil chog gi gzhung las/ dpa' bo'i snying po'i gsang sngags ni/ /khri phrag gsum du bzlas brjod bya/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo/ /khri phrag gnyis ni bsnyen pa bya/ /ka kha'i gdong sogs brgyad po dang / /stong phrag lnga dang lnga brgya ni/ /sngon du bsnyen par 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ rje btsun gyi nag po dkyil chog las/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po'i sngags ni khri phrag gsum bzlas te/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzā la samba ram̐ swāhā/ oṃ baidzra bai ro tsā nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes bya ba'o/ /'khor lo gsum gyi sngags ni khri phrag gnyis gnyis bzlas te/ de yang yab yum gyi sngags rdzogs par bzlas kyang btub/ yab kyi hūm̐ phaṭ dang / yum gyi oṃ bcad nas bzlas kyang btub ste/ de'ang rgyas par byed na 'di skad du/ oṃ ka ra ka ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pra tsaṇḍe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa lta bu'o/ /bsdus na/ oṃ ka ra ka ra pra tsaṇḍe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa lta bu'o/ /snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang / sgo mtshams ma brgyad la lha re re la rang rang gi sngags stong phrag lnga dang lnga brgya pa re bzlas te/ de yang oṃ ḍā ki ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa dang / oṃ ka ka sye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa ste/

zhal bzhi pa dang / rkang pa brgyad pa ni spel mi dgos so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi sngags kyi grangs rnams de bzhin du bzla dgos pa yin la/ yang bdag gi bla ma mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa'i drung du bdag gis dri ba zhus pa'i gsung lan las/ bsnyen pa kha gso shin tu bsdus pa'i phyogs ltar na/ yi ge bdun ma rkyang pa la bzhi khri'am/ yang na yab yum gyi snying po gnyis gang rung gi rnam rgyal bum pa'i bzla bya'i sngags sarba buddha tsam la bzhi khri bzlas pas kyang chog pa 'dra ste/ sbyin sreg gi skabs su bsdus pa'i lha sngags yi ge bdun pa dang / 'bring gi lha sngags yab yum gyi snying po gnyis dang / yum gyi nye snying gsum gang rung gis bya ba dang / rgyas pa'i lha sngags lha thams cad kyi rang rang gi sngags kyis bya bar rje sa skya pa chen pos gsungs pa yin zhes rgyud sde'i mnga' bdag rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang pas nag po lugs kyi sbyin sreg las bshad pa 'di'i 'gros sbyar bas bsnyen pa'i phyogs kyang rtogs nus pa 'dra snyam du sems pa lags/ zhes gsungs pas 'di yang skal bzang gi dpyod ldan dag gis snying gi dkyil du bcang bar bya zhing / de ltar gzhi bsnyen dang kha gso'i sngags kyi grangs tshad rnams nges par byas te/ ji ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshul ni/ gnas khang yid du 'ong bar rten dang mchod gtor sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin bshams la/ rang nyid rten la kha phyogs par stan nang tshangs can la 'dug ste/ thun gsum la sogs ba'i bya bas/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bzhin nyams su blangs la/ bzlas pa byed dus gzhi bsnyen gyi skabs kyi dmigs pa ni sgrub thabs de nyid du gsal zhing / kha gso'i dus kyi bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mngon sum lta bur mos la/

sngags phreng phyir 'gro ba'i tshe 'od zer de dag la phog pas dmar lam lam song bas bdag gi dbang du 'dus shing / ser lam lam song bas tshe dang bsod nams/ rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad rgyas par bsam/ nang du 'jug dus de dag gi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam pas rang la thim pas sdig sgrib dag cing / rgyud byin gyis brlab par bsam la bzla/ thun 'jog pa dang / nam mkhar dmigs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rang la thim pas dngos grub thams cad stsol bar bsam pa tsam khyad par yin pas nges par bya'o/ /kha gso'i skabs 'dir gong du bkod pa ltar/ ma mo bcu gnyis la spel med du bzla ba bsdus pa'i lugs de bzhin byas chog pa sngags 'chang chen pos bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang chog gi dbu na gsungs pa de bzhin du bya'o/ /zhes 'khor lo bde mchog gi bsnyen pa bya tshul gyi yi ge 'di yang rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi bran du gyur pa sa skya pa chos med snyom las mkhan sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis bya lo sa ga zla ba'i dmar cha tshes la bzhi thog bla brang gi tshoms dmar du mgyogs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gdong dga' ba bsam pa don chen no/ /'dis 'khor lo bde mchog gi bsnyen sgrub dar rgyas su gyur nas/ dpon slob thams cad mkha' spyod thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 a myes zhabs/ 'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i gzhi bsnyen dang kha gso'i bsnyen pa byed tshul gyi yi ge/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
